findings.explanation: The contract assigns ownership of all work product to the client as it is created, before you receive full payment.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Work Product shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has paid all fees due under this Agreement, at which point ownership shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose an adjustment before signing. - In the relevant clause, ownership of work product is assigned to the client as it is created, prior to full payment. I propose modifying this so that ownership of the Work Product shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has paid all fees due under this Agreement, at which point ownership shall transfer to the Client. Thank you, I look forward to working together.
